Records.description: 4-mass ladder family, ladder4pt_L7_massless-internal-offshell-external. Planar L-rung box ladder: rails t_1..t_{L+1}, b_1..b_{L+1}; rail edges (t_i,t_{i+1}), (b_i,b_{i+1}); rungs (t_i,b_i); 4 off-shell external legs at t_1, t_{L+1}, b_1, b_{L+1}. 2L+2 vertices, 3L+1 propagators, L loops. Massless internal lines.
Records.title: An approach to the evaluation of three and four point ladder diagrams
Records.authors: N. I. Usyukina, A. I. Davydychev

Records.description: Basso-Dixon fishnet family, basso-dixon_L7x1_massless-internal-offshell-external. Basso-Dixon fishnet B_{M,N}: an M x N rectangular grid, 4 external operators at the corners, defined in dual (region-momentum) space via products of 1/x_ij^2 propagators. The L = MN loop integral is conformal. Momentum space: the (M+1) x (N+1) vertex grid (2MN+M+N massless edges, 4 off-shell corner legs, MN loops); B_{M,1} = the M-rung 4-pt ladder; transpose symmetry fixes the canonical orientation M >= N.

Results.normalization: Exact finite conformal integral: the weight-14 Usyukina--Davydychev function $\Phi^{(7)}(z,\bar z)$ (the $7$-loop ladder), written as explicit classical polylogarithms $\operatorname{Li}_j$ in the conformal cross-ratios $z,\bar z$ (grounded in the external kinematics; the external scale prefactor is stripped). Not a dim-reg series. The numeric is its value at the reference point $z=1/3$, $\bar z=1/5$.

source.title: Exact results for three and four point ladder diagrams with an arbitrary number of rungs
source.authors: N. I. Usyukina, A. I. Davydychev

import.method: Usyukina-Davydychev box ladder: value is the closed-form weight-2L single-valued polylogarithm Phi^(L)(z,zbar) evaluated at z=1/3, zbar=1/5. Box dictionary G^(L)_box = Phi^(L)(u,v)/(s t^L), sigma=+1, validated by pySecDec at L=1 (rel err 5e-9) and L=2 (3.7e-5); see notes/normalization_validation_2026-06.json.
